text:
Mira Patel: quick sync  launching a compact newsletter for the inference benchmark + a lightweight 2-email nurture. main constraints: minimal assets, geo send windows, and clear replay routing.
Jon Holt: propose send windows: Americas Thu 10am PT, EMEA Fri 10am CET, APAC Mon 10am SGT. seed & ISP checks 24h prior.
Sofia Ramos: segmentation: inbound_tag=bench_post OR utm_campaign=bench_launch -> invite list. high_intent = clicked_bench_cta OR visited=/benchmarks/docs -> immediate invite; others to 48hr nurture. I'll prep filters and export Wed 6am PT.
Kai Chen: ops: set 5% canary for first 8 minutes; pause if bounce_rate > 1%. webhook payload example for sales tag: `{"lead_id":"{{id}}","tags":["bench_inbound"],"source":"benchmark_post"}`. retry policy = 3.
Mira Patel: copy asks: 1) two subject variants (generic + dev-focused), 2) 25-char hero line, 3) 90-char preheader. Sofia, can you draft by Tue EOD?
Sofia Ramos: will do. also uploading two hero options (chart vs human) to the drive: https://drive.redwood/bench-assets
deliveries-bot: Calendar event created: "Benchmark newsletter + microdrip" Thu 10:00 PT  invites: #marketing #growth.
Jon Holt: analytics: I'll build a small dashboard tracking open->register->replay (72h window for regs, 14d for replay). posting link when ready.
Mira Patel: final owners: Jon (analytics), Sofia (copy+assets), Kai (ops/webhooks), Mira (launch). timeline: copy+assets Tue EOD, export Wed 6am PT, seeds Wed 9am PT, Americas Thu 10am PT.
Kai Chen: noted. will confirm canary + timezone splits after CSV upload.
Mira Patel: thanks team 680 keep QA chatter in-thread during the 2-hour window before send.
